=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/scripts/edit_comment.py:132-140 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The allowlisted runtime helper bounds its read and post-read check in decoded text-mode characters rather than bytes.
  WHY: A scratchpad file that grows after `fstat` with multibyte UTF-8 content can pass the character-count check while consuming more than `MAX_INPUT_FILE_BYTES` in bytes; the allowlisted helper can then PATCH that data into a comment.
- .claude/scripts/edit_comment.py:132-140 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A declared-vs-effective capability gap exists between the workflow-template definition and the allowlisted executable runtime script.
  WHY: `.claude/settings.json` allows `Bash(python3 .claude/scripts/edit_comment.py *)` without prompts, but the runtime helper lacks the twin's byte-bounded read fix; `tests/test_edit_comment.py:364-365` fails because the copies differ.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "[claude-twin-sync] copy into .claude/scripts/edit_comment.py" — the last unchecked item in the PR description checklist, and the progress log at line 24 "review of 6a48797 (workflow round 1) fix: [claude-twin-sync] copy of workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/edit_comment.py into .claude/" still shows unchecked.
  Expected change site: .claude/scripts/edit_comment.py, read_input_file at lines 132-140 and imports at line 46
  Evidence of absence: The runtime copy at line 132 uses `os.fdopen(fd, encoding="utf-8")` with text-mode `handle.read(MAX_INPUT_FILE_BYTES + 1)` and `len(text)` (character count). The twin at lines 133-143 uses `os.fdopen(fd, "rb")` with binary `handle.read(MAX_INPUT_FILE_BYTES + 1)` and `len(data)` (byte count), followed by `io.TextIOWrapper(io.BytesIO(data), encoding="utf-8").read()`. The runtime copy has no `import io` (twin line 46). The progress log at line 10 shows "Waiting on: PR #5465: twin sync 3" and line 25 marks Status as BLOCKED. `tests/test_edit_comment.py::test_template_parity` requires byte-identical copies at line 364-365 and fails. The changelog fragment and `agents.md` describe the byte-bounded behavior that only the twin implements. The phase is blocked on twin sync 3 as a documented hold in the twin-first workflow (CLAUDE.md §28.C interim), but until the sync lands, the allowlisted runtime helper that actually executes under the `Bash(python3 .claude/scripts/edit_comment.py *)` permission rule still carries the character-counting vulnerability described under SECURITY above.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

- .claude/scripts/edit_comment.py:46, 132-140 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: There is a declared-vs-effective capability gap between the workflow template and the allowlisted executable runtime script.
  WHY: `.claude/settings.json` pre-approves the runtime script, but the byte-bounded binary read fix was applied only to the workflow-template copy.
